def transform(grid):
    # Keep the left template panel and replace its interior with right-side colored shapes,
    # matching by shape identity irrespective of orientation, in sequence.

    # right has colored object per corresponding band.
    out=[]
    # In demos template frame occupies left 6 cols, right objs cols 7 onward.
    # For each band, map target shape to input colored shape by matching occupancy up to rotations/reflections.
    def norm(a):
        pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(a) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
        if not pts:return ()
        mr=min(r for r,c in pts); mc=min(c for r,c in pts)
        return tuple(sorted((r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in pts))
    def variants(a):
        mats=[]
        for flip in (False,True):
            b=[row[::-1] if flip else row[:] for row in a]
            for k in range(4):
                mats.append(b)
                b=[list(row) for row in zip(*b[::-1])]
        return {norm(m) for m in mats}
    # identify horizontal separator rows as uniform nonzero color
    seps=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=0]
    bounds=[-1]+seps+[h]
    out=[row[:len(grid[0])//2+1] for row in grid]
    # Per template segment, find corresponding right object and paint into left zeros.
    for bi in range(len(bounds)-1):
        top,bot=bounds[bi]+1,bounds[bi+1]
        if top>=bot: continue
        # template window left between outer frame columns (identified from separator color)
        frame=grid[seps[0]][0] if seps else grid[0][0]
        # template interior is cols 1..(separator vertical frame?) detect matching frame columns
        framecols=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==frame for r in range(h))]
        leftmax=(framecols[1] if len(framecols)>1 else w//2)-1
        # colored object in right half segment
        cells=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(top,bot) for c in range(w//2,w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,frame)]
        if not cells: continue
        color=cells[0][2]
        obj=[[int(any(rr==r and cc==c for rr,cc,_ in cells)) for c in range(min(x for _,x,_ in cells),max(x for _,x,_ in cells)+1)] for r in range(min(y for y,_,_ in cells),max(y for y,_,_ in cells)+1)]

        # demo task reorders objects into templates according to shape matching. Match occupancy against left blank interior.
        tmat=[[1 if grid[r][c]==0 else 0 for c in range(1,leftmax+1)] for r in range(top,bot)]
        target=norm(tmat)
        # choose colored objects across all bands matching template shape
        candidates=[]
        for aa,bb in zip(bounds[:-1],bounds[1:]):
            vals=[(rr,cc,grid[rr][cc]) for rr in range(aa+1,bb) for cc in range(w//2,w) if grid[rr][cc] not in (0,frame)]
            if vals:
                cc=vals[0][2]; mat=[[1 if any(y==r and x==c for y,x,_ in vals) else 0 for c in range(min(x for _,x,_ in vals),max(x for _,x,_ in vals)+1)] for r in range(min(y for y,_,_ in vals),max(y for y,_,_ in vals)+1)]
                if norm(mat)==target: candidates.append(cc)
        paint=candidates[0] if candidates else color
        for r in range(top,bot):
            for c in range(1,leftmax+1):
